description:
List all available Noteboxd chart rankings (e.g. top-rated, trending, top by brand). Returns chart names and summary stats.

See also: `chart_get` with a chart slug to see the full leaderboard · `trending` for a quick snapshot of what's hot.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

name: charts_list
